answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can hinge on delayed stake unlocks: each new identity must deposit scarce compute credits into a shared vault and wait through a velvet cooldown before earning vote weight. During that window peers score mechanism answers; only quartz-hard attestations from distinct fingerprints unlock the deposit. Clones that spam cheap identities burn stake without ever clearing the cooldown, so forging a majority costs more than honest work.
